method: New code-drawn high-resolution text and shapes from exact U105 official photographs, rasterized directly. No photo crop or enlargement is used as a texture. Only final ordinary PNG is distributed.
limitations: Typography, colour, line shape, diagram arrangement and physical registration are reconstructed visual details.

Front Direct Digital Synthesis title and SINE/SQUARE/TRIANGLE/SAWTOOTH curves and back DDS/UNIT/OPA365/AD9833/STM32/SPI/MCLK/I2C/25MHz/PORT.A.I2C/SCL/SDA/5V/GND are transcribed from same-model photos.
Curves and block diagram are fixed printed artwork, not generated waveforms or circuit simulation.
Observed25MHz rear print is preserved; it does not resolve the10MHz product-text versus25M schematic reference-clock question.
No unreadable identifiers, serial numbers or QR patterns are invented. Source photographs, vector originals, private source tables and generation assets are not distributed.
